new_result.statement: For a fixed-row/fixed-column anchored squared 3-minor packet of mass Z and h>1/2, a two-level inclusion-marginal decision tree either stops at a conditional-diffuse row/column law or produces an actual physical 3x3 minor carrying more than (2h-1)^2 Z of squared determinant mass. In N3(tau), that terminal minor yields a six-coordinate principal block with s3 >= (2h-1)sqrt(Z)/(9(tau+tau^2)), hence a full-form density bound 108 sqrt(pi)(tau+tau^2)/((2h-1)sqrt(Z)).
